title: Attention Is All You Need
layout_note: Two vertical towers side by side: the encoder on the left (shorter, two sub-layers) and the decoder on the right (taller, three sub-layers), each wrapped in a rounded grey frame marked 'Nx'. The encoder output leaves the top of the left frame and bends across into the decoder's middle attention block; Linear and Softmax boxes sit above the decoder only.
grouping: Each repeated layer is a light-grey rounded frame labelled 'Nx' beside it (left of the encoder, right of the decoder). Inside, each sub-layer is a coloured block paired with a thin yellow-green 'Add & Norm' bar directly above it; residual connections are drawn as lines that leave below the block and loop around its side into the Add & Norm bar.
shapes_depth: Flat rounded rectangles with dark outlines and pastel fills that encode block type: orange for (Masked) Multi-Head Attention, light blue for Feed Forward, pale yellow-green for Add & Norm, pink for Input/Output Embedding, lavender for Linear, green for Softmax. Positional encoding is a circle with a sine-wave glyph joined by a circled-plus. Thick black arrows; three-pronged arrow forks feed Q, K, V into each attention block.
proposed_highlight: No single module is singled out: the whole architecture is the contribution, and colour-by-block-type lets the reader see that the attention blocks (orange) recur in both towers, with the decoder's extra cross-attention block fed by the line coming over from the encoder.
lesson: Colour each block by its type (attention, feed-forward, norm, embedding) rather than by stage, so the same operation is recognisable wherever it repeats across two towers.
notes: Venue from the first page (31st Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems, NIPS 2017). Caption reads 'The Transformer - model architecture.' The figure is portrait (taller than wide).

arrangement.units: two vertical lanes, encoder (left) and decoder (right); each holds a rounded light-grey frame around the repeated layer labelled 'Nx', with embeddings and positional encoding below the frame and (decoder only) Linear + Softmax above it
arrangement.inputs_as: plain words 'Inputs' and 'Outputs (shifted right)' under the two Embedding boxes
arrangement.losses_at: no loss drawn; the decoder ends in 'Output Probabilities' text above the Softmax box at the top right
arrangement.shared: the encoder output is one line that leaves the top of the encoder frame and drops into the decoder's second attention block; nothing is duplicated

insights.structure: Encoder and decoder stand as two upright grey-framed towers marked 'Nx', side by side, with the decoder taller by one extra attention sub-layer and topped by Linear and Softmax.
insights.data: Data appears only as words at the ends ('Inputs', 'Outputs (shifted right)', 'Output Probabilities'); no tensors or token cells are drawn, only the operations.
insights.emphasis: Pastel fills code block type (orange attention, blue feed-forward, yellow-green Add & Norm, pink embeddings), so the repeated attention blocks stand out in both towers without any extra highlight.
insights.flow: Both towers read bottom-to-top along a central spine; residual lines loop out the side of each sub-layer back into its Add & Norm bar, and one line crosses from the encoder top into the decoder's middle block.
insights.avoid: The encoder-to-decoder line enters the cross-attention block as three forked arrows that are hard to tell apart from the decoder's own residual line next to them, so which input is K/V versus Q is not readable from the drawing.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)
